units: metres; rotation matrix rows; quaternion xyzw (w>=0)

frames.TCP: closed-fingertip contact midpoint; axes parallel to the front optical frame: +x image-right, +y image-down, +z optical-forward
frames.CAM0_OPTICAL: lens-0 dome rotation axis (CAD-exact: both dome spheres on-axis to <1e-4 mm); origin 2.5 mm behind bare outer lens vertex; z out of lens, x image-right, y image-down (roll convention vs real image readout: +y=image-down supported by fingers-at-image-bottom in real footage; x sign to be pinned by one frame check)

matrix_direction.T_tcp_camera: maps points FROM CAM0_OPTICAL frame TO TCP frame: p_tcp = R @ p_cam + t (= pose of camera frame expressed in TCP frame)

origin_geometry.note: TCP origin in the camera frame is retained exactly from this CAD asset; only the TCP basis is redefined. No new physical calibration.

method: Original UMI axis convention: TCP orientation equals front camera orientation; retain the X3-specific camera-to-fingertip translation.

uncertainty.optical_centre_depth_along_cam_z_mm: +/- ~1.0 (was +/-2.0): caliper T +/-0.2, factory-baseline parameterization spread +/-0.25, front/back symmetry assumption +/-0.5, effective-viewpoint non-uniqueness (pupil walk) +/-0.75 conservative
uncertainty.camera_roll_convention: x sign vs image readout to be pinned with one recorded frame (y=image-down already supported)
uncertainty.tcp_axis_convention: Defined by front_optical_parallel_v1; no mechanical jaw-axis sign is needed.
uncertainty.verification_required: fingertip jig + AprilGrid or hand-eye+pivot before any 'verified' status; formal training gate unchanged
